title: The cohomology sheaves of the naive cotangent complex of a morphism of algebraic spaces are quasi-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the cohomology sheaves of the naive cotangent complex of a morphism of algebraic spaces are quasi-coherent. The proof constructs the naive cotangent complex through a chart presentation, identifies its cohomology sheaves with the corresponding sheaves computed on the chart, and uses that those are quasi-coherent because they are built from modules of differentials and conormal sheaves of etale-local presentations. Tracking the identification of the cohomology sheaves across the chart is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 5397-5403 with the surrounding argument.
